integrity: Theorem proved by exact eigenspace calculations and PBH. Finite checks illustrate but do not prove the infinite family. Unindexed equivalent literature cannot be excluded.
scientific_limitations: Only m>=3, 2<=k<=m, two equal complete graphs with unit edges, fixed undirected Laplacian, and independent coordinate inputs. Not a universal strong-structural statement or extension to unequal weights.
title: Exact minimum dedicated-leader sets for cliques joined by a partial matching
